SEPARATE BOT CASE STUDY

Aladdin Alert Bot

Token monitoring, Telegram alerts and outcome analysis.

Built a token-monitoring and Telegram alert workflow, then analysed what happened after the alerts. The supplied main-period records cover 11,142 unique tokens from 29 June to 15 September 2026. My work connects data collection, outcome measurement and practical product evaluation.

Export-based analysis, not realised returns or win rates. Baseline and observation gaps apply; the source database and live service were not independently verified. This report covers the alert bot only, not the terminal or blockchain LLM.
